note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: Pending real-bash confirmation, then fixed: git global options whose values contain spaces now read word by word instead of by a joined regex (antigravity); redirects are their own tokens, so a redirect glued to a quote or a quoted filename is seen (antigravity, codex); a greater-than-ampersand redirect to a file counts as a write (antigravity); any env option other than a double dash voids a hatch set before env (antigravity, glm, qwen); side effects are tracked whether or not the command carries the prefix, including a prefixed command that could write commit text anywhere (glm); a compound command closer carrying a redirect marks the text written (glm); dollar-brace expansions are lexed as one word and their interiors checked (deepseek); taint propagates through variable-to-variable copies (codex lead).
rounds.notes: 6 of 8 returned output: antigravity (first time in the reviewer role), codex (partial), deepseek, glm, minimax (SOUND), qwen. Copilot absent.
